advantage_gate: all six adjusted empirical lower bounds exceed0.005 and each of three seed means is positive; failed gates stay reported
amendment: Before confirmation, move delayed query from slot7 to slot6 so one-segment interlayer transmission completes; preserve all prior development in aborted_delayed_observability_v1. No hyperparameter changes.
architecture: two hidden layers, three units per layer, two public input channels, one scalar readout; one-segment interlayer delay
bootstrap: resample model seeds, then paired complete examples; stochastic repetitions stay within an example
confirmation_access: forbidden in development; only after explicit source and checkpoint FREEZE.json validation
delayed_match_timing: cue slot0, distractors slots1..5, query slot6, transmission slot7
fairness: same train/development/confirmation identities and examples, identical update counts and learning-rate budget; no wall-time equality claimed; inference repetitions recorded
first_passage_backward: biased straight-through conditional-renewal-moment surrogate; local moments use analytic finite count sums and order8 Gauss-Legendre refractory integrals; not an unbiased objective gradient
first_passage_forward: sample every continuous first passage, exact killed-survivor endpoint, physical reset and positive deterministic refractory; continue all remaining time
lif_backward: sigmoid surrogate for threshold and refractory-release discontinuities
lif_forward: Euler leaky integrate and fire, leak1, twenty substeps per segment, hard events, reset and refractory release quantized to substeps
limited_claim: three-seed controlled synthetic comparison; neither universal cross-task superiority nor population coverage is established
optimizer: Adam with default betas and epsilon; float64
physical_anchor: initial membrane voltage0 in fixed observed units; threshold0.5..1.4, reset-0.2..0.2, diffusion0.08..0.4, refractory0.04..0.18
primary_comparisons: six baseline-minus-first-passage single-rollout expected cross-entropy differences across three tasks and two baselines
randomness: Matched example identities and named RNG seeds; adaptive samplers consume different random draws, so no common-Brownian-path coupling across model families is claimed.
rnn: two-layer leaky tanh recurrence with learned gains and time scales;55 active coefficients
selection: lowest development binary cross entropy among the eight registered epoch checkpoints
